messages:
kyle_sales: Hey team — Nebula POC needs a hosted API key. Requirements: 10d TTL, rotate day 4, allowlist 198.51.100.128/25, require a scoped read-only monitoring token for their SREs (metrics only), and a documented 'safety kill' test we can run to prove revocation works. Also need CORS allowed for demo web host https://demo.nebula.example.

jana_se: We can do a workspace-scoped main token + a separate monitoring token scoped to telemetry:read only. CORS origin can be added as token metadata. For revocation proof we usually do a planned revoke + immediate verification and provide redacted logs.

pete_security: Security notes: redact prompts/responses in logs, 60d audit retention for this POC. Monitoring token must be strictly read-only (no completions). Test evidence must include request IDs and timestamps.

lena_ops: I'll provision two keys: main + monitor. TTL 10d, rotate-after 4d, pre-demo refresh 30m. Add allowlist and CORS. Webhook on revoke to #sales. Internal CLI (ops-only):

```
redwoodctl keys create \\
  --workspace nebula-poc \\
  --owner kyle_sales \\
  --name nebula-main-2512 \\
  --ttl 10d \\
  --rotate-after 4d \\
  --allowlist 198.51.100.128/25 \\
  --cors https://demo.nebula.example \\
  --redact-logs true \\
  --audit-retention 60d \\
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/nebula/revoke

redwoodctl keys create \\
  --workspace nebula-poc \\
  --owner kyle_sales \\
  --name nebula-monitor-2512 \\
  --scope telemetry:read \\
  --ttl 10d \\
  --allowlist 198.51.100.128/25 \\
  --redact-logs true \\
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/nebula/revoke
```

revokebot: Created keys: key_NEB_MAIN555 (expires 2026-05-05T12:00:00Z), key_NEB_MON555 (expires 2026-05-05T12:00:00Z). Rotation scheduled at day 4. Audit logging enabled (redaction: true). Webhook configured.

kyle_sales: Please DM the main key to me securely. Also schedule a safety-kill test tomorrow 09:00 UTC: 1) revoke main, 2) run a test call to verify 401, 3) reissue and verify 200. Paste the two curl outputs (redacted) and request IDs here.

pete_security: Approved. Evidence must include timestamps and request IDs.

lena_ops: Will run the safety-kill at 09:00 UTC and paste redacted outputs. Revoke CLI for ops: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_NEB_MAIN555 --reason "safety_test"`. Post-revoke example curl (expected 401):

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer key_NEB_MAIN555" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```

Reissue and verify will return 200. I'll include redacted logs showing request-id and timestamp.

kyle_sales: Great, thanks — I'll tell Nebula SRE to expect the test. :rocket:
